title: intake's drift budget test holds on a loaded host
goal: test_intake.py::test_intake_drift_a_check_sleeping_past_the_budget_stops_the_scan_and_the_rest_are_counted passes on a loaded host: the planted check reaches its own timeout before the scan budget runs out (a fake clock or a margin that does not depend on host speed), so the gate does not fail on it when other sessions load the host; reported by mac-first, whose sync gate saw timed_out == [] under load while the test passed alone in 8 s
